```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
noble <- read_csv("dane/nobel_laureates.csv")
```

```{r}
noble %>% 
  drop_na(birth_continent) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y = birth_continent, fill = category)) +
  geom_bar() + 
  theme_minimal()

p_1 <- noble %>% 
  drop_na(birth_continent) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y = category, fill = birth_continent)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") + 
  theme_minimal()

plotly::ggplotly(p_1)
```

```{r}
noble %>% 
  filter(str_detect(birth_country, "Russia")) %>% 
  select(known_name, birth_city, birth_country)
```

```{r}
noble_polska <- noble %>% 
  filter(birth_country == "Poland" |
           birth_country_now == "Poland" |
           death_country_now == "Poland") %>% 
  mutate(known_name = fct_reorder(known_name, birth_date) %>% fct_rev(),
         death_date = replace_na(death_date, today()))

p <- noble_polska %>% 
  ggplot() +
  geom_segment(aes(x = birth_date, xend = death_date, y = known_name), linewidth = 10, colour = "grey30") +
  geom_text(aes(birth_date, known_name, label = known_name), 
            colour =  "white", 
            fontface = "bold", 
            size = 3.5, 
            hjust = 0, 
            nudge_x = 500) +
  geom_text(aes(x = birth_date, y = known_name, label = paste("★", birth_year)),
            hjust = 1, nudge_x = -400, size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
  labs(title = "Nobliści powiązani z Polską", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank()
  )

ggsave(filename = "noble_polska.png", plot = p, path = "wykresy/", units = "cm", width = 34, height = 30, dpi = 300)
```
